proposition: All Demerzel state instances conform to their declared JSON schemas — specifically PDCA states (logic/kaizen-pdca-state.schema.json) and autonomous-loop states (schemas/loop-state.schema.json)

supporting.claim: Personas (17/17), tetravalent beliefs (5/5), contract schemas (11/11 valid JSON Schema), and reconnaissance profiles (3/3) all conform to their schemas.

logic/kaizen-pdca-state.schema.json was rewritten to match real instance shape (cycle_phase, hypothesis, kaizen_kind, plan/do/check/act objects). All 8 state/pdca/*.pdca.json instances now validate successfully against the amended schema.

The duplicate loop-state schemas were collapsed to one source of truth: logic/loop-state.schema.json was deleted and schemas/loop-state.schema.json is now the single enforced copy (used by demerzel_kit.py at write time). Both state/loops/*.loop.json instances validate successfully against schemas/loop-state.schema.json. Issue #852 closed as superseded.

Re-verified 2026-09-12 against the proposition's explicit scope (PDCA states and autonomous-loop states): 0/8 PDCA instances and 0/4 loop-state instances fail validation. Both dissenting items dated 2026-07-25 predate the 2026-07-28 fixes already recorded in this belief's supporting evidence.

resolved_contradictions.claim: All 8 state/pdca/*.pdca.json instances fail validation against kaizen-pdca-state.schema.json. Instances use fields cycle_phase/hypothesis/kaizen_kind and lack the schema-required proposition/model/phase/belief_state/iterations. The schema and instances have diverged.
resolved_contradictions.resolution: Superseded by this belief's own supporting evidence: logic/kaizen-pdca-state.schema.json was rewritten to the real instance shape (cycle_phase, hypothesis, kaizen_kind). The item was never retired after the fix.
resolved_contradictions.resolution_verified_by: jsonschema Draft7 validation on 2026-09-12: 0/8 state/pdca/*.pdca.json fail; schema required fields are ['id','cycle_phase','hypothesis'], which the instances carry

resolved_contradictions.claim: Both state/loops/*.loop.json instances fail validation against loop-state.schema.json. Instances use loop_id/risk/repo/governance_mode while the schema requires id/risk_level/target_repo/worker/reviewer/current_iteration/convergence.
resolved_contradictions.resolution: Superseded by this belief's own supporting evidence: the duplicate loop-state schemas were collapsed to schemas/loop-state.schema.json, whose required fields match the instances (loop_id, risk, repo, governance_mode). The item was never retired after the fix.
resolved_contradictions.resolution_verified_by: jsonschema Draft7 validation on 2026-09-12: 0/4 state/loops/*.loop.json fail; logic/loop-state.schema.json is absent as intended
